title: Crash in list type inference
body:
Minimal example:

```
def foo(blocks: Any):
    to_process = []
    to_process = list(blocks)
```

Note that there is no import of Any from typing. If I add the import, the crash disappears. All three lines apparently contribute to the crash. Traceback:
